name: Phase B3-A
label_cohort: B2 regular, three paired seeds, same 107-material historical holdout

bootstrap.unit: exact evaluation chemistry group, averaged over paired seeds

static_reference_primary: A1 dedup_nearest, 2469 environments, frozen A1/A2 baseline settings
ensemble_stage_policy: Use complete B1 cached profiles only. Additional three-member inference is not a static extraction in B3-A.

aggregation.reaction_integral: trapezoid on normalized PBC-unwrapped Li arc
aggregation.peak_position: earliest normalized coordinate attaining the maximum; undefined for a flat profile
aggregation.baseline: centered-energy SD as primary, raw and start-anchored as sensitivity. Barrier SD is already path-level.

analysis.primary_view: One path one row; mean static distances and mean B1 disagreement; standalone barrier SD
analysis.association: Spearman, pairwise complete paths with n always shown; no p values
analysis.leave_one_out: Delete each path, keep labels and features fixed; requires at least 3 remaining paths
numeric_confounders: initial Li hard CN at 3 angstroms
analysis.interpretation: Stable exploratory lead if abs(mean-profile rho)>=0.5 and each defined path deletion retains sign on >=10 paths. Other summaries are reported as secondary.
